about: Fixed-term glossary for the five interface languages. Source of the terms: CONTEXT.md. Any text-table string whose zh-CN text contains a term must use the listed translation in every other language (case-insensitive). Add a term here before using a new fixed term in the tables.

Realistic (photo) or painterly; not 'style'.
Re-make an image changing one direction only.
